product.ta-bss-300.summary: The BSS 300 combined a computer, screen and typewriter in one office workstation.
product.ta-bss-300.history: Triumph-Adler presented it as an office writing system. By 1993 it had service documentation in German and English.
product.ta-bss-300.technical.configurati: The typewriter was separate from the display and computer. The surviving brochure shows all three components.
product.ta-bss-300.technical.verified: BluMach has no runnable profile for this model.
product.ta-bss-300.technical.limitations: The typewriter interface and software for the complete system remain pending.
